title: X-LAB RS8 frameset specification
notes: Official mainland RS8 frameset page: the frameset includes a carbon integrated handlebar and carbon seatpost; frame weight 850 g for an unpainted size-M frame excluding fork and seatpost; carbon fork with 12×100 mm thru-axle and flat-mount brakes; the same five-size geometry as the complete bike. Its related-product panel lists the frameset at CNY 10,980 and the complete bike at CNY 21,980.
